item.title: Ministers must explain
item.description: Story Created: Oct 7, 2014 at 7:42 PM ECT. Far too many unanswered questions remain around the now-rescinded plan to buy out the vacation leave of assistant Commissioner of Police Wayne Dick. ACP Dick is the man in charge of the supposedly ongoing investigation of the murder of Senior Counsel Dana Seetahal, who was shot and killed on May 4. item.title: It is not only race and ethnicity ...
item.description: Everywhere in the world, people vote parties into government on the basis of factors like race, ethnicity, and religion, and in Trinidad and Tobago, the observation is clear. Far more Indo-Trinbagonians will vote for the United National Congress (UNC) than for the People’s National Movement (PNM); far more Afro-Trinbagonians will vote for the PNM than for the UNC; far more Hindus will vote for the UNC than for the PNM; far more Christians will vote for the PNM than for the UNC; Tobagonians will.

item.title: A grave abuse of power
item.description: By Mickey Matthews What the UNC does not get is that Dr Wayne Kublalsingh did not mount the environmentalist platform as part of its strategy to unseat the PNM but in pursuit of a principle in which he believes strongly. By any measure this is a real advance for Trinidad and Tobago and it brought him moral stature as that became clear.
